escena: SCENE (cinematic still, a dark modern office at night): Nexa sits at a dark walnut desk, framed from the waist up, a slim open laptop in front of her whose screen faces away from the camera; she looks at the lens with a calm half-smile, her hands on the desk. The Spark HOVERS over the desk beside the laptop, at the right of the frame, at the height of her shoulders, tilted forward and looking down at the laptop as if working on it, its small hands forward. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens; her head stays almost frontal, both eyes and both eyebrows visible, and only her eyes move. She wears the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard, no watch, no rings. The Spark is copied EXACTLY from its reference image: the glossy white hovering sphere with navy visor, azure LED eyes and smile, sparkle antenna, tilted white orbit ring with its small sphere and three azure belly windows; it is about the size of her head, never larger, and floats above her waist. The Spark's own azure LEDs are a real light source that lights her face softly. A cool rim light from behind outlines both of them; light haze. No logos of any other brand, no readable text.
